author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Want a professional email signature that looks great in both the new Outlook desktop app and Outlook on the web? In this step-by-step tutorial, I’ll show you exactly how to create, format, and manage email signatures—including how to use Microsoft Copilot to generate a signature with a photo in seconds.

In this video, you’ll learn:
 - How to create an email signature in the New Outlook for Windows
 - How to set up and edit a signature in Outlook on the web
 - Add and format images and photos in your signature, as well as hyperlinks
 - How to use Microsoft Copilot to generate a polished, professional email signature
 - How to create multiple signatures 
 - Common formatting issues (and how to fix them)

Whether you’re a business professional, small business owner, or just want a cleaner, more modern email signature in 2026, this tutorial walks you through everything—no design skills required.

Host: Elizabeth Parker
